text_original: 新加坡在地人称它为半熟蛋。 咖椰酱有两种, 绿色的Kaya酱在制作时加入了斑兰叶, 所以呈现绿色及斑兰叶的香气。 褐色的Kaya酱俗称海南咖椰。 一般上两颗蛋的量只需加入半茶匙的黑酱油就可以了, 加太多会死咸。当然如果个人口味重的可以再加一 点, 但吃的太咸对健康不好。
text_en: Singapore locals call it 'half-boiled egg'. There are two kinds of kaya: green kaya has pandan leaves added when made, so it's green with a pandan aroma; brown kaya is commonly called Hainanese kaya. Usually two eggs only need half a teaspoon of dark soy sauce — too much and it's deathly salty. Of course if you like it stronger you can add a bit more, but eating too salty is bad for your health.

text_original: 清末，海南島瓊州是最後一個開放海禁。所以，海南人來到馬來亞和新加坡謀生，所有的行業被其他籍貫的人給把持。他們唯有替土生華人和英國人打工，繼承了英國人西餐的一套。一點很多人不知道，Kaya其實源自於葡萄牙，葡萄牙人稱呼為Si Kaya。
text_en: In the late Qing dynasty, Qiongzhou on Hainan Island was the last to lift the sea ban. So when Hainanese came to Malaya and Singapore to make a living, every trade was already held by people of other origins. They could only work for the Peranakans and the British, and inherited the British way of Western cooking. Something many people don't know: kaya actually originates from Portugal; the Portuguese called it 'Si Kaya'.

text_en: I live in Singapore myself and think your Singapore videos and food recommendations are good, balanced and natural — very suitable for first-time visitors! text_en: Singapore has many everyday breakfast foods: nasi lemak, roti prata, fried bee hoon, chee cheong fun (rice-flour rolls), fried carrot cake, steamed buns, soon kueh, ang ku kueh, egg cake, soy milk with youtiao, Western pastries and toast, and so on — something for every budget. Ah Kun's [Ya Kun's] set is not what ordinary Singaporeans must eat every day; sorry, but picking only one shop to introduce will mislead netizens into thinking Singapore lacks local food. If you have a toaster at home, you can toast your own bread, spread kaya and butter and have it with a cup of black coffee — a heavenly breakfast. Do try more of Singapore's multiracial everyday breakfasts.

text_original: 去年的8月18号，凌晨四点钟我自己一个坐在跟你很接近的坐位上，吃亚坤的士司，水煮蛋还有一杯咖啡。因为所有的免税商店都关了，只能够用Terminal 2的免费WiFi,一边滑手机，一边看着飞机起飞。 后来我才发现原来楼上其实有MacDonald和食阁。。 过后就赶去Boarding gate坐酷航的6点的飞机前往香港旅行。我希望以后要是我再乘搭酷航的飞机能见到你本人，还有你的亲切的笑容。 💖💖💖
text_en: Last year on 18 August, at 4am, I sat alone in a seat very close to yours eating Ya Kun toast, boiled eggs and a cup of coffee. All the duty-free shops were closed, so I could only use Terminal 2's free WiFi, scrolling my phone while watching planes take off. Later I found there was actually McDonald's and a food court upstairs.. then I rushed to the boarding gate for Scoot's 6am flight to Hong Kong. I hope that if I fly Scoot again I'll meet you in person and see your warm smile. 💖💖💖

text_original: 当今好多个人碎片记忆与经历都寄放在云端上，或是手机里头。2017年在日本广岛，我看了火车站邮局，莫名买了邮票写了几行拉屎字在明信片上，投寄给远方在韩国讨生活邻居小孩与及坡地老友。没想到自己亲手写笔迹尽然带给他们喜悦 😂 不会是数码化PK古老的较真吧 ？？？ 😁
text_en: Nowadays so many personal fragments of memory and experience are stored in the cloud or on phones. In 2017 in Hiroshima, Japan, I saw the post office at the train station, randomly bought stamps, scribbled a few lines on postcards and mailed them to a neighbour's kid making a living in Korea and old friends in Singapore. I didn't expect my own handwriting to bring them such joy 😂 Is this digital vs old-fashioned earnestness??? 😁

text_original: 別再只吃亞坤了!! 新加坡海南人百年KOPITIAM 炭火現烤麵包半熟蛋才是道地| 新加坡自由行EP20 || 這支影片帶您造訪號稱新加坡第一家、歷史最悠久的海南人咖啡店——Killiney Kopitiam（舊名瓊和興）。不同於現代連鎖店，這家店至今仍堅持以火炭烘烤麵包，呈現傳統的碳香味，搭配招牌咖椰醬和完美的半熟蛋，被我認證為「比雅坤更好吃」的道地風味。  影片中特別點了新馬傳統早餐套裝，並深入探討了咖椰醬（Kaya）的文化意義，以及海南人如何在早期南洋謀生，將歐洲的咖啡、麵包與馬來、華人飲食文化融合，最終創造出獨特的新馬 Kopitiam 文化。  最令人驚喜的是，這裡的咖哩雞塊搭配麵包獲得我極高評價，咖哩醬汁濃郁，雞肉大塊入味  如果您到新加坡旅遊，想品嚐最正宗、最棒的平民美食早餐，Killiney Kopitiam 絕對是不能錯過的選擇。影片最後也詳細介紹了新馬咖啡店的點餐術語，如 Kopi、Kopi O、Kopi C 等的區別。強烈推薦給所有熱愛新馬美食文化的朋友！  Killiney
text_en: Stop only eating Ya Kun!! A century-old Singapore Hainanese KOPITIAM — charcoal-toasted bread and half-boiled eggs are the authentic way | Singapore independent travel EP20 || This video visits Killiney Kopitiam (formerly Qiong He Xing), billed as Singapore's first and oldest Hainanese coffee shop. Unlike modern chains, it still toasts bread over charcoal for a traditional smoky aroma; with its signature kaya and perfect half-boiled eggs, I certify it as authentic flavour 'better than Ya Kun'. I ordered the traditional Singapore-Malaysia breakfast set and explored kaya's cultural meaning and how early Hainanese in Nanyang fused European coffee and bread with Malay and Chinese food cultures, creating the unique Singapore-Malaysia kopitiam culture. The curry chicken with bread was a highlight. If you visit Singapore and want the most authentic, best everyday breakfast, Killiney Kopitiam is a must. The video ends with kopitiam ordering terms like Kopi, Kopi O, Kopi C.

my first try at ya kun kaya toast 🍞 after studying in singapore for two years… i had high expectations but tbh its not that different from the breakfast set i had at school? 
来新加坡留学两年了终于有机会尝试亚坤；本来期望挺高的但是说实话跟我在学校吃的早餐套餐并没有很大的区别？

firstly the kaya 🥥 wasn’t as fragrant as i expected. and they gave a bit too much butter in each bread to it was too salty…
首先那个咖椰味道并没有期待中的那么浓厚. 而且每片面包里的黄油都太多了所以每口咬下去都很咸…

as for the soya milk coffee, it wasnt as sweet as the traditional kopi. But at the same time the soya taste wasnt rly strong too.
再然后那个豆奶咖啡跟传统的kopi比起来没那么甜. 但同时豆奶的香味也不是特别足. 尝起来就一般吧！！

Ya Kun Kaya Toast di Mall Taman Anggrek jadi salah satu spot favorit buat yang lagi cari sarapan atau ngopi santai dengan cita rasa khas Singapura. Banyak yang bilang kaya toast-nya renyah di luar, lembut di dalam, apalagi dipadukan sama selai kaya dan butter yang lumer. Kopi dan teh tariknya juga sering dipuji karena rasanya kuat, creamy, dan pas buat nemenin camilan. Meski kadang harus antre di jam ramai, banyak pengunjung merasa rasanya tetap worth it dan konsisten. Kalau kamu lagi di Taman Anggrek, tempat ini wajib masuk daftar kuliner yang harus dicoba.

#yakunkayatoast #foodreview #kulinerjakarta #foodrecommendation #fyp
